Industrial Disputes Act, 1947-Section 2(oo)(bb)-Regularization­ Adhoc employee appointed for specific period-On expiry of that period re- C appointed after a gap of 1-2 days-Held, adoption of such course of action by employer was with an object to defeat the purpose of Act-S.2(oo)(bb) is not cannot be regularized-Hence, compensation of Rs. 2 5000 awarded-­ Labour Jaws-Compensation. D Respondent was appointed on adhoc basis initially for a fixed period. E On expiry of the fixed period, she was reappointed each time for the same period after leaving a gap of 1-2 days. She absented
